verdict.rationale: LiteLLM's proxy explicitly supports virtual keys to control model access and track spend for keys/teams/users, letting platform engineers issue scoped keys to teams/apps without exposing underlying provider credentials (docs-5, docs-8, docs-6, docs-7, docs-26). However, community evidence shows real operational concerns, including a supply-chain compromise and a report of 'issues with creating tokens for other users,' undercutting confidence in robustness at scale.
